name: Lead Capture
job: Enroll new next-lander contacts, guard against duplicate Sales opps (create-once), stamp Method 2 clinic context, send the welcome email + STOP SMS, and hand unbooked to WF-02 after 24h.

trigger.notes: Sole enroll: Contact Created + Has Tag next-lander (EA2hrrIHTrlFvEEt6RzH). No source filter. Empty source defaults to next-lander; wordpress-form is only an inner branch elsewhere, never a trigger filter.

named_steps.name: WAIT: 10s so upsert fields are visible
named_steps.comment: Short settle so /api/qualify + /api/handoff/wordpress upserts land on the contact before FIND-OPP reads them.

named_steps.name: IF: Open Sales opp already exists? (create-once)
named_steps.comment: Native find-opp guard against a second open opp on staging Sales pipe ASnpfhu1hpSHUv0IFLc7. Must not move stages, must not read monetaryValue for logic.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: last-touch only (open opp exists)
named_steps.comment: Found branch. Refresh last-touch fields on the existing open opp; do not create a duplicate.

named_steps.name: PATH: no open Sales opp
named_steps.comment: False branch of the create-once guard. Downstream CREATE-OPP fires only from this path.

named_steps.name: CREATE: Sales New Lead (Lead to Close)
named_steps.comment: Only reached when no open Sales opp exists. Staging Sales pipe ASnpfhu1hpSHUv0IFLc7, stage New Lead 31a81ba6-10c4-4033-8401-4e864ec9495c. Allow Duplicate Opportunities is ON but this branch is gated by the create-once guard. Must not set monetaryValue.

named_steps.name: IF: location = richmond
named_steps.comment: First slug arm of the Method 2 stamp block; reads contact.current_clinic_slug.

named_steps.name: PATH: richmond
named_steps.comment: True branch of the richmond guard. Downstream stamps run only from here.

named_steps.name: PATH: not richmond
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through; next slug IF still evaluates.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_clinic_address (richmond)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 address stamp for richmond. Field a2v4CqA8zXaZ0iu901f6. Value: 4050 Innslake Drive Suite 360 Richmond VA 23060.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_clinic_phone (richmond)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 phone stamp for richmond. Field k7ci7d1rnExhAVtEE768. Value: (804) 346-4636.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_booking_url (richmond)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 booking URL stamp for richmond. Field W74Kznhixhaq5sJWbk4r. Value: https://book.menswellnesscenters.com/richmond.

named_steps.name: IF: location = virginia-beach
named_steps.comment: Second slug arm of the Method 2 stamp block; reads contact.current_clinic_slug.

named_steps.name: PATH: virginia-beach
named_steps.comment: True branch of the virginia-beach guard.

named_steps.name: PATH: not virginia-beach
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through; next slug IF still evaluates.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_clinic_address (virginia-beach)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 address stamp for virginia-beach. Field a2v4CqA8zXaZ0iu901f6. Value: 996 First Colonial Road.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_clinic_phone (virginia-beach)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 phone stamp for virginia-beach. Field k7ci7d1rnExhAVtEE768. Value: (757) 612-4428.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_booking_url (virginia-beach)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 booking URL stamp for virginia-beach. Field W74Kznhixhaq5sJWbk4r. Value: https://book.menswellnesscenters.com/virginia-beach.

named_steps.name: IF: location = newport-news
named_steps.comment: Third slug arm of the Method 2 stamp block; reads contact.current_clinic_slug.

named_steps.name: PATH: newport-news
named_steps.comment: True branch of the newport-news guard.

named_steps.name: PATH: location unmatched (no stamp)
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through for a slug outside {richmond, virginia-beach, newport-news}. Nothing stamps.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_clinic_address (newport-news)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 address stamp for newport-news. Field a2v4CqA8zXaZ0iu901f6. Value: 827 Diligence Drive Suite 206.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_clinic_phone (newport-news)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 phone stamp for newport-news. Field k7ci7d1rnExhAVtEE768. Value: (757) 806-6263.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_booking_url (newport-news)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 booking URL stamp for newport-news. Field W74Kznhixhaq5sJWbk4r. Value: https://book.menswellnesscenters.com/newport-news.

named_steps.name: IF: inbound slug = richmond
named_steps.comment: Copy the inbound clinic slug onto opportunity.location XbaJOEsDwgxMtudnj5IG so the Sales opp carries the display label. Must not touch opportunity.monetaryValue.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: opportunity.location from slug (richmond)
named_steps.comment: Writes opportunity.location = Richmond (display label).

named_steps.name: PATH: not slug richmond
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through for the richmond slug guard.

named_steps.name: IF: inbound slug = virginia-beach
named_steps.comment: Copy inbound slug to opportunity.location display label for virginia-beach.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: opportunity.location from slug (virginia-beach)
named_steps.comment: Writes opportunity.location = Virginia Beach (display label).

named_steps.name: PATH: not slug virginia-beach
named_steps.comment: False branch fall-through for the virginia-beach slug guard.

named_steps.name: IF: inbound slug = newport-news
named_steps.comment: Copy inbound slug to opportunity.location display label for newport-news.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: opportunity.location from slug (newport-news)
named_steps.comment: Writes opportunity.location = Newport News (display label).

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_review_link (richmond)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 review-link stamp for richmond. Field 5WQWnA1nuMn0SWwTLxKR. Live richmond listing review URL, opaque string; workflow just stamps it.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_review_link (virginia-beach)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 review-link stamp for virginia-beach. Field 5WQWnA1nuMn0SWwTLxKR. Live virginia-beach listing review URL, opaque string; workflow just stamps it.

named_steps.name: UPDATE: Stamp current_review_link (newport-news)
named_steps.comment: Method 2 review-link stamp for newport-news. Field 5WQWnA1nuMn0SWwTLxKR. Live newport-news listing review URL, opaque string; workflow just stamps it.

named_steps.name: EMAIL: Welcome after first capture (WF-01)
named_steps.comment: Sends native template EML | WF-01 | Welcome (j7C8MVs6cAIuH5zPUjzH). Copy respects the locked rules (members not patients, clinic not office, no-cost not free, no em-dashes, no guy).

named_steps.name: SMS: Speed-to-lead first touch + STOP (WF-01)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS. First SMS in any sequence carries Reply STOP to opt out. Transactional; send window None.

named_steps.name: WAIT: 24h then hand unbooked to WF-02
named_steps.comment: GHL unit is singular hour, not hours. Transactional; not quiet-hours aware.

named_steps.name: ADD: Enroll WF-02 (unbooked 24h)
named_steps.comment: ADD-TO-WF WF-02 5f973b3c-0375-4fc0-ace2-e13d1a1976b9. WF-02 enforces its own funnel_entry_* exclusion; do not filter here.
